cr_data.provenance:
September 16, 1957, sold by Downtown Gallery, New York (stock no. 103) to William H. Lane (b. 1914 - d. 1995), Standard Pyroxoloid Corporation, Leominster, MA [see note 1]; 1990, partial sale and partial gift of William H. and Saundra B. Lane to the MFA. (Accession Date: June 27, 1990) 
 
NOTES: 
[1] Archives of American Art, Downtown Gallery Records, Series 4, Business Records: Sales Slips (2 of 3), 1957: Reel 5628 (Box 73), Frame 1023. 
(Source: MFA Boston, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March, 1946. . . . No signature [note of backing inscription 1]. Reddish purple barns." Abiquiú Notebooks notes backing inscription 2. Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold 1957 Downtown Gallery." Stretcher inscription 1 possibly indicates date of preparatory work. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1924? Dated 1922/1924 on basis of stretcher and backing inscription 1. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication dates this work as 1922–1924. MFA Boston dates it as 1922. (Source: MFA Boston, 2025)

titles.notes: Source of title: backing inscription 1, Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Ends of Barns

credit_line: Partial gift of William H. and Saundra B. Lane and Museum purchase with the Juliana Cheney Edwards Collection—Robert Jacob Edwards Fund, Emily L. Ainsley Fund, and Grant Walker Fund
description: Two dark red barns, situated perpendicularly, meet at the center of the composition. The barns both have black pitched roofs. Below the structures, a yellow ground stretches along the bottom of the composition. A pale blue sky is visible above the barns.
title: Ends of Barns
